release_notes:
UPDATE v1.1.4

SCHEDULE TAB - 500+ ACCOUNT RELIABILITY:
1. Fixed healthy accounts wrongly marked "Failed" during large (500+) Schedule runs
   - Masked Chrome-creation error (unbound exception) now captures the real error
   - Chrome-creation lock wait relaxed so batch contention no longer fails good accounts
   - Added bounded account-level retry/re-queue for transient/infrastructure failures
   - Leaked Chrome/chromedriver processes from stuck workers now reaped between batches
   - RAM-based concurrency cap is now logged (observable) instead of silently throttling
   - Per-account status/timer routing uses a stable unique id (fixes misrouted status)
   - resource_guard now passed consistently across queue and batch paths
   - Single source of truth for batch size (SCHEDULE_BATCH_SIZE)

CRASH FIX:
2. Fixed AttributeError crash on auto-resume after resource recovery during Schedule/Automation runs (pause/resume controls are now tab-aware and guarded)

ALL PREVIOUS FIXES INCLUDED:
- Schedule Tab UI & Worker improvements (v1.1.3)
- Immediate Stop Crash Fix (v1.1.2)
- Browser Count Decrement Fix (v1.1.1)
- User Config Respect (v1.1.1)
- 200+ Accounts Crash Fix (v1.1.0)
- Batch Cleanup Fix (v1.1.0)
- Auto-Start Fix (v1.1.0)
- Resource Timeout Fixes (v1.1.0)

STABILITY:
- All previous stability improvements maintained
